steps.text: 'Lord, I hope you're enjoying Ursus.'
'I've arrived in Columbia. It's an interesting place - the only word I have to describe it.'
'I've been thinking about a question that we've all heard of or thought about. We might just trace the value and raison d'être of a good many things back to it.'
'Is the history that we're familiar with just a roll of the dice, or is there a degree of inevitability?'
'What would the world look like if we turned back the clock ten thousand years and allowed things to play out one more time?'

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: I think they've left.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: How can you tell?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Footsteps.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: I always heard at least one set of footsteps at the mouth of the cave, but now it's all quiet. Something must have happened.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: How many days have we been in here?

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I think this is day three.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: That puddle reflects a little bit of sunlight at dusk.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Maybe most of the group left. What are we waiting for?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: I've had enough. I'm heading out now.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: We can cut the rope behind me. Let's get out of here.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: There's at least a dozen of them, all of them armed. We don't even know why they kidnapped us.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: At least they didn't kill us on the spot. This is our chance.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Maybe we should wait. If we get on the wrong side of them...

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: You can stay here and wait for death if you want.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Me, I'm going. Columbia is so close. If I'm gonna die, I would rather not die here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Need a hand?
'It's been some time since we arrived in this strange world. I can't say I'm used to life here yet, and I'm sure the same is true for you.'
'But if you ignore the unfamiliar creatures for a minute, you will find this world more familiar than you might think.'
'It may sound strange, but this is where my mind is.'
'We should do what we can to understand it.'

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: From the tracks here, it looks like the main group left three days ago. Unfortunately, my car broke down the day before I ran into you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It doesn't look like we'll be able to catch them.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Oh no! I knew they wouldn't wait for us.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Who would stop to wait when the wealth of Columbia awaits?

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: But we paid them. They didn't even try to find us...

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: The barrens are a dangerous place. They didn't want to linger, even for a day...

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Life is about looking out for number one. We just have to live with it. Never, I say, never count on someone else!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I agree, and complaining won't do any good. We're on our own here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: According to the map, the closest village is about a hundred clicks to the south. We'll need to resupply there.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: South? But we're going west!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: An ancient eastern philosopher once said: need to save food for three months for a thousand-mile journey.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Food? Not money?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Never mind... anyway, we'll need to prepare, if we want to make it where we're going.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: There's no time to complain. Put yourselves together; we're leaving.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Alright, one more time.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your name is Erwin. You're a Caprinae, and you hail from Leithanien.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You're ruled by the Twin Empresses, and you have a lot of people who are skilled in the... Originium Arts.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Don't forget our proud musical tradition.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your name's Nikola. You're from Ursus, and your race is Ursus too.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Yes. The name Ursus is feared by many nations, and by many of its own people.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your name is Alicja. You're from Kazimierz, home to the famous knight sports.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I have some questions about these knight sports.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: These are corporate-sponsored fights to the death by hired warriors, forming an important part of the Kazimierzian economy.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The 'knights' competing in these competitions are considered stars, even heroes, and human life is a commodity.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: That's what people who have been to the big cities say.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Strange, but not incomprehensible.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: May I ask a frank question? You're clearly a skilled warrior, seeing how you saved us from those bandits.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: But your knowledge about our lands seems to be rather lacking.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Where exactly are you from?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Pardon me. I come from a place that is, shall I say, pretty far away.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: That doesn't really matter. She saved our lives; we should trust her.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We're in this together, at least for now, since we're going to the same place.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You said you were traveling as a group, heading for Columbia?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Victoria, Gaul... now Columbia.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Nikola, Erwin and I set out from a village in western Kazimierz, as part of a pioneer group.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: You've heard of the Great Expansion, haven't you?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Great Expansion... yes, I've heard the word.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Of course you have! Even someone who hasn't heard of the Kazimierz Major must have heard of the Great Expansion! Who could hear the name and not feel their heart race?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Just imagine! Massive nomadic cities roaming the wilds, delivering supplies to farms and mines, showering you with money in exchange for goods!

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Yeah! I heard that Columbia has endless expanses of land waiting to be cultivated. No one will take your lands from you, and everything you grow belongs to you.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: You can have an entire farm, if you're willing to work hard!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Wait a second, brother. Where's your ambition?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: A farm? Mines are where the real money is!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Excuse me. By 'mines', do you mean Originium mines?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Of course! What else?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But aren't they a source of infection?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: And Catastrophes - nomadic cities can avoid Catastrophes, but not mines and farms. Won't that threaten your dreams?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Sounds like Columbia is telling you there's a chance to get rich here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: People from around the world risk their lives to help Columbia expand its borders, without the government putting any skin in the game.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: You say such strange things...

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Of course mining is dangerous - even a burdenbeast knows that. So what? Look at this thing on my neck. What do I care about danger?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I meant no offense. I'm not making any accusations. I'm in no position to do that.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Catastrophes are pretty low on the list of things that can lose you your farm.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: You never know when a Catastrophe might take your farm in the barrenlands, but you know for sure that your lord will take your farm in Ursus.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You're right - we all have to try to survive.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: And I hear you can have a good life in Columbia as long as you have money, whether you're Infected or normal, Caprinae or Sarkaz. Now THAT's what I call fair.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: I never thought you Leithanians were concerned about these things.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: The Infected are pests anywhere, it's just that Leithanien isn't so diligent about pest control.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: But none of this matters once we arrive in Columbia.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: You're right. Everything will be fine once we get to Columbia.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Have any of you ever been to Columbia?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Never.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Don't worry, we've all heard the stories.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: I saw a movie about a poor Sargon kid who made his fortune in Columbia!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: The Columbians have no taste in music, but that movie thing is pretty interesting.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Yeah, interesting. I think I've seen that movie before.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: My father went to Columbia...

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I got a letter from him a month ago, saying he's settled down there, and inviting me to join him.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Your father's in Columbia? You never told us!

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I-I still can't believe it... he left home so many years ago. Who knows how long it took for the letter to reach me from Columbia...

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Ah, now I get it!

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Someone knew your dad got rich in Columbia and hired people to kidnap you for ransom! Everything makes sense now!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Ah, so we two poor sods got dragged into the mess of a rich man's daughter?

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Think on the bright side, brother! This proves that you really can strike it rich in Columbia!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Y-You're right!

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Are you sure that's what happened?

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Of course it is! What else could it be!

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Looks like getting kidnapped wasn't such a bad thing!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Sister, we've been through hell together. You should tell us what your dad does once you find him!

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: That's right! Let's share the wealth!

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: What about you? Why are you going to Columbia?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Same as you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Looking for a job.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Excuse me, may I look at the map?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: This is... yes! It must be! This hill! Right here!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: See that? That's City No.9! Have you ever seen a nomadic city that big?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: It'll be the center of a new Columbia-Kazimierz highway that will open up trade between the two countries - even the intercity net!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Columbian films will enter the Kazimierzian market, and the Major finals in The Grand Knight Territory will be broadcast in real-time in Columbia!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: The stories are true!

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: It's so big...

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: I've never seen anything that big in my life.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's a monumental landmark alright.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: I'll work there someday. I'll make my own fortune. No one can stop me—
'Massive cities sail the wasteland under a setting sun, a scene surreal and awe-inspiring in equal measure.'
'But we all know that spectacular wonders are often built from mundane bricks, even downright ugly ones.'
'The glamorous surface always hides the same lies.'
'The eyes of everyone here are full of dreams, a kind of pure, naive passion that I've only seen in the eyes of the most loyal warriors and most innocent children.'
'But I don't know what awaits them ahead.'
'Or perhaps we all know how the story ends, because history has shown it too many times.'

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Recoil will throw your aim off, if you're tense.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Relax. The key is in the rhythm of your breathing.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Very good. Line up your sights with the target, then squeeze the trigger.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Not bad, for a first try.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Less meat for dinner, though.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Does everyone learn to use this, where you come from?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No... we take up arms so others can lay them down.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I hope the day will never come when you have to take up arms. But if it comes, you'll be glad you learned this.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Crossbows might be more useful for you guys. I have a friend who would've been a good teacher, if she was here.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I know how to use a bow! I've even hunted with it!

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I fantasized about becoming as skilled as the knights... but I gave up practicing after dad gave me a scolding.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Interesting. I had a similar experience myself, though I wasn't so obedient.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Choose your own way for yourself, when you start your new life.

steps.name: Ursus Villager (no portrait)
steps.text: We've got firewood. We can make dinner now.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's go. You must be hungry.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Aren't you hungry?

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: These sandworm cans are the only food we have left. It's a little salty, but food is food.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: I kind of like it. If only we had some rye bread.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No argument there... I'll have some. Food in this place is safe to eat, as far as I can tell.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's... not too bad.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Mm... I feel so warm.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Hot food always makes you feel that things aren't so bad, right? Like there's always a way.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Of course. Columbia is a stone's throw away. Soon we'll be starting new lives.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Hear, hear.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Let's not forget this!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Booze? Where did you find it?

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: I grabbed a couple of things when we left that cave. Payback for getting us separated from the caravan.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Can't read the label though. Looks like it's in Columbian...

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Nice! A drink is exactly what we need right now.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Too bad I sold my cello in Leithanien, or I would play something for us.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Didn't realize you had that up your sleeves.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: What could be more shameful than a Leithanian who doesn't play an instrument?

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Here's to music! And to the new cello that you'll buy once you've made your fortune in Columbia.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: A drink, sister?

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: S-Sorry, I'm not much of a drinker.

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: Too bad. Not many chances to drink your fill like this back home.

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Too bad, too bad. Well, brother, prost!

steps.name: Ursus Villager
steps.text: To a new life!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: To Columbia!

steps.name: Leithanian Worker
steps.text: Look at me, I almost forgot about the fraulein. Care to join us?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Sorry, I'll pass.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'd love to join, but I need to stay alert tonight.
A short distance from the camp.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Line of sight isn't great. We should have made our move earlier.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Don't worry, they won't get out of the forest.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Careful. They might still be with the one who hit our camp.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: We're ready this time. We'll make them pay.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Stay here while I scout ahead. If I get a shot...

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Back so soon?
He's not coming back.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Experienced, but not professional enough.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Put down your weapon.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: It was you—

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Sure was.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Please answer the rest of my questions just as honestly.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Who sent you?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Eat sh—

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'm not in a great mood today. If this is how you want to continue the conversation, I'm happy to oblige.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Why did you kidnap them?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Money.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Farms and mines always need new labor. There's always business to be done with pioneer groups traveling across the wasteland.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Why those three?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Those three? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: You killed our guys. We came after you!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: What are you waiting for?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: You won. The remaining supplies and ammo are yours.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Do it!
'I didn't write this to accuse. I'm in no position to do that.'
'As they say, you should not criticize someone until you have walked a mile in their shoes.'
'This is an interesting world, one that is different from ours. It is like a mirror, and we must reflect upon what it is reflecting.'
'I have learned a lot in this world.'

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Where did you go?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I took care of a little problem.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I heard strange sounds...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's all fine now.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Get some sleep. You'll need it for the journey ahead.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: But I can't sleep...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Well then, come sit with me and we can have a little chat.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I'm not sure why, but I feel afraid.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's normal to fear the unknown. It's called caution, and it's a good thing to have.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What are you worried about, Alicja?

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: I'm not sure... the others are so excited for Columbia, and they can't wait to get there.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: But the more eager they are, the more concerned I get. Can it really be as good as the stories say? What kind of place is Columbia, actually?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's a good question, but the wrong person to ask.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I come from a place far away, you know that. I'm way less familiar with this land than you. We're going to learn about it together.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's see it with our own eyes. We don't have to blindly believe the words of others, or the experiences of the past. We'll observe and think.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But first, we'll need to get there. We need to keep walking.

steps.name: Kazimierzian Girl
steps.text: Keep walking...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Keep walking.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If that's not enough to set your mind at ease, let me tell you a story.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: A story of a place that's very much like Columbia...
